messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — GPU_POOL_SATURATION in us-east1. queue_depth > 95% for 12m, avg_latency increasing. paging @maria (oncall). https://alerts.redwood/INC-3712349999 :rotating_light:
maria (oncall): on it. grabbing runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-surge. first look at queue metrics now.
jordan (sre): seeing steady queue inflow from primary route - spike at 10:37 UTC, spike correlated with campaign X. pooling logs show repeated preemptions, autoscaler attempts failing due to quota error: `InstanceLimitExceeded`.
lina (eng-runtime): autoscaler reports 'scale_attempt=3' then 'scale_failed: quota' around 10:45. also many warmup errors: `kv_cache_miss` causing longer startup.
maria (oncall): timeline: queue_growth started 10:25, crossed 90% at 10:30, pager at 10:37. impact: elevated tail latency for high-priority tenants, intermittent 503s for low-priority.
ashley (customer-ops): customer support notes: 3 SLO alerts from Beta customers, some chatbots returning "service unavailable". flagging customer emails to SME.
jordan (sre): quick mitigation options: 1) enable cross-region spillover to us-west1 2) temporarily reduce low-priority rate limits 3) switch to fallback model variant (medium) for non-enterprise traffic. which do we want now?
maria (oncall): do 2 + 1 concurrently. throttle low-priority first to buy runway. lina, can you flip spillover gate?
lina (eng-runtime): on it. running `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/route-gates/us-east1/spillover -d '{"enable":true,"to":"us-west1"}'` now. returning 202. will monitor.
ty (eng-platform): raising infra quota request with provider, but ETA for quota increase is hours. not helpful for immediate.
jordan (sre): throttling rule applied: `rate_limit: tenant_tier=free -> 0.3rps` via config `throttle-config/v2`. patch rolled, confirmed by controlplane logs: `throttle_applied` at 10:52.
maria (oncall): observed immediate drop in queue inflow rate for free tier. queue depth slope leveling. good.
incident-bot: ROUTE_CHANGE — spillover enabled from us-east1 -> us-west1, policy=latency-prefer-primary. requests rerouted at edge in ~60s.
lina (eng-runtime): edge reports show 12% of traffic now spilling to us-west1. latency for spilled requests ~ +60ms. fine for our SLOs.
jordan (sre): still seeing backlog for enterprise tenants pinned to us-east1. note: pinned workloads aren't eligible for spillover. we should apply temporary canary fallback: allow enterprise fallbacks to medium model variant to reduce memory footprint.
maria (oncall): decision: enable model-fallback for tier=enterprise for 20m window. lina, apply policy. tie to rollout id `fallback-3712349999`.
lina (eng-runtime): applied `fallback-3712349999` — enterprise requests will accept variant=medium if primary fails to acquire capacity. rollout hit 100% in 45s.
jordan (sre): monitoring: enterprise queue length dropped 40% after fallback. token generation latency down 30%. customer-ops, inform impacted customers about fallback and expected slight quality drop.
ashley (customer-ops): drafting message to impacted accounts. note: only a subset will see lower quality; majority unaffected. sending to PMs now.
maria (oncall): next: we still have autoscaler flaps. manual scale attempt succeeded for one pool at 11:05 (added 4 nodes) but provisioning delayed due to warmup time ~3m. pumps helped but not enough. need medium-term: reserved capacity request.
ty (eng-platform): filing reserved capacity ticket to procurement and infra with priority P0. ETA for capacity commit ~48h. ticket: https://tickets.redwood/RES-1123.
jordan (sre): rolling restart avoided. we removed a hot shard by evacuating some requests with `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/pools/us-east1/evacuate -d '{"pool":"hotpath-1","drain_to":"hotpath-2"}'` — drain in progress, new backpressure metrics expected.
maria (oncall): telemetry check: backpressure downstream (KV cache misses) still visible. adding KV cache warmup hint to rollout for spilled region. lina, can you enable prefix cache prewarm for us-west1?
lina (eng-runtime): enabled prefix prewarm for top 20 prefixes, hit cache E2E load scripts. warming in 2m.
jordan (sre): metrics update at 11:18: total queue depth dropped from 97% -> 62%. p50/p95 latency trending down. errors still elevated for some customer routes pinned to specific server groups.
maria (oncall): customer impact summary: - High-priority customers: degraded latency but service restored via fallback/spillover. - Free tier: rate-limited, calls returned 429 in peak window. - Enterprise pinned tenants: some experienced brief model-quality fallback. No data leaks, no user-facing error codes beyond 429/503 for small window.
ashley (customer-ops): outreach sent to 12 flagged accounts, CS triage opened for 3 escalations.
sre-lead: thanks team — good execution. please keep tracking for 2h post-mitigation and collect evidence for postmortem. capture config diffs: `throttle-config`, `fallback-3712349999`, `spillover-gate`.
jordan (sre): creating incident Jira: RED-INC-3712349999, logging symptoms, timeline, mitigations.
maria (oncall): I'm moving this to monitoring mode. handoff to night oncall in 2h. tagging followups: reserved capacity request, autoscaler bug root cause (quota handling), warmup improvements, better pinned-tenant fallback policy.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS — mitigated -> monitoring. severity reduced to SEV2. incident closed for paging at 11:50 UTC, will remain open for postmortem tasks. :white_check_mark:
